root_cause.proof: Actual workflow now obtains a fresh UUID from scripts.ci.apple_verification_hygiene create-simulator apple-ui; old contract required direct selection of an existing profile. The correction replaces that obsolete expectation with exact named-step preparation, owned creation, nonparallel launch, fresh xcresult, owned DerivedData, correctly bound always-run finalizer, and immediate ordering.

counter_evidence: Original build-vs-test check remains. It still rejects replacing XCTest with an xcodebuild build.
Both original error-producing tests now actually execute and pass; assertions were not removed or weakened.
Named-step extraction is for the explicitly reviewed static workflow shape, not a general YAML security parser. Unique required markers and immediate-finalizer ordering are validated.

Preparation runs before effective identity xcodebuild calls and the launch. If the run skips/fails/cancels after a successful claim, the always-run same-cycle finalizer retains real outcome and first stops Gradle.

Fresh simulator helper copies only a public type/runtime, not profile contents; it rejects preexisting UUIDs/names and refuses arbitrary clone deletion. Existing helper regressions cover failed/interrupted creation, survivor devices and unquiesced workers.
Release identity collision safeguards, job disablement, secret restrictions, Action pins, exact Xcode26.3/17C529 policy and no-build promotions remain byte-for-byte unchanged in this two-file patch.
Game/session/protocol/resources are untouched. No Store credentials, native app runtime or physical device claim arises from Python fixture execution.
